Tooltip_GrenadeBandolier: Provides 4 grenade attachment slots. Drag grenades onto the attachment icons to holster them there for quick access - it is not a storage container.
Tooltip_FlareBurning: A lit signal flare, burning brightly and giving off sparks and smoke. Throw it to mark a location or light up the area.
Tooltip_FlareSpent: A burnt-out signal flare. No longer useful.
Tooltip_ClaymoreRemote: An M18A1 Claymore mine fitted with a remote trigger instead of a motion sensor. Detonate it from a distance using a remote control.
Tooltip_Explosives_DEBUG_SPAWN_KEY: Hold Shift and press this key to spawn a single flashbang directly into your inventory, for testing grenade trajectories/collisions without needing full debug mode.
